mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, district, detail_address, label, is_default, create_time, update_time FROM user_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, update_time DESC, id DESC
SELECT id, user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, district, detail_address, label, is_default, create_time, update_time FROM user_address WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT id, user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, district, detail_address, label, is_default, create_time, update_time FROM user_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_address WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_address (user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, district, detail_address, label, is_default) VALUES (#{userId}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{detailAddress}, #{label}, #{isDefault})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_address SET is_default = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_address WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
